title: Canonical Governed Context Capsule
goal: Establish one governed deterministic source for all agent-facing and future model-facing context so duplicate state reconstruction is replaced by a single canonical capsule and thin compatibility wrappers.

core_rule.statement: All agent-facing and future model-facing context must originate from governed_context_capsule_v1; compatibility wrappers may only project fields from that capsule and may not independently reconstruct governed state.
core_rule.effect: Deterministic context assembly becomes canonical, duplicate retrieval is eliminated where possible, and the capsule remains the sole governed pre-inference surface.

problem_statement.current_state: Multiple agent-facing scripts independently assemble or shape context surfaces around the same runtime state, increasing duplication and stale-context risk even when no inference occurs.
problem_statement.gap: The repository lacks a single named canonical context capsule surface with explicit required sections, stable serialization, and content-addressed reuse that every consumer must use.
problem_statement.risk: Independent reconstruction of governed state can diverge, inflate prompt surfaces, and complicate future inference accounting.

basis.scope: Consolidate deterministic context assembly and capsule reuse without introducing model calls or altering semantic readout gating.

required_repo_changes.description: Formalize build_governed_context_capsule_v1 as the canonical governed context producer with deterministic ordering, stable serialization, explicit provenance, and content-addressed reuse.
Convert retrieval to a thin consumer of governed_context_capsule_v1 instead of independently reconstructing governed state.
Convert packet building into a view over governed_context_capsule_v1 rather than a second state-assembly path.
Convert claim context generation into a compatibility adapter that selects fields from the canonical capsule.
Convert trace context generation into a compatibility adapter that selects fields from the canonical capsule.
Convert memory context generation into a compatibility adapter that selects fields from the canonical capsule.
Convert execution context generation into a compatibility adapter that selects fields from the canonical capsule.
Synchronize the governed runtime note so the textbook references the canonical capsule without weakening claim discipline.

metrics.token_estimation_policy: Token estimation may use a deterministic approximation and must be labeled estimated unless a specific tokenizer is invoked.

acceptance_criteria: All agent-facing context scripts use the canonical capsule.
No compatibility wrapper independently reconstructs governed state.
Stable serialization and cache invalidation tests pass.
No network or inference dependency is introduced.
Before-and-after build time and context size are recorded.
Rollback restores the previous independent paths.
success_criteria: The canonical capsule is the sole governed pre-inference context surface.
Wrapper outputs are derived only from the canonical capsule.
Capsule reuse is content-addressed and invalidates on governed state change.
The textbook note remains humble and RT_core-invariant.
No model call is introduced by capsule construction or wrapper execution.
